acceptanceCriteria: `sh script/no-python-runtime-dependency_test.sh` exits 0 on main: integrations/pi and integrations/pi-protected (build.mjs, runtime.test.mjs, startup.test.mjs, host.test.mjs) no longer invoke a Python interpreter, or GOC-V0-008 is amended by the owner with a named, bounded exception for test-only PTY fixtures.
The test runs in an existing gate (a Makefile target that `make gate` or CI reaches), so a new Python invocation fails that gate; the wiring is traced from GOC-V0-008.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 while reviewing V1-0198. `script/no-python-runtime-dependency_test.sh` (the GOC-V0-008 falsifying assertion, docs/specs/go-only-cutover-v0.md:84) exits 1 on main at 01b6804 with 6 hits: integrations/pi-protected/build.mjs:32 (extracts the node binary with python3 tarfile), integrations/pi-protected/runtime.test.mjs:96 and integrations/pi/host.test.mjs:161,242 (python3 tui-fixture.py PTY driver), integrations/pi-protected/startup.test.mjs:47-48 (python3 fork fixture). No Makefile target, script or workflow invokes the test, so the drift went unnoticed. build.mjs is a packaging path, which GOC-V0-008 forbids outright; the test fixtures need a Go or Node replacement for the PTY and fork helpers, or an owner-accepted exception.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-24 by PR #131 (merge e9a6e5456). Criterion 1: sh script/no-python-runtime-dependency_test.sh exits 0 at 6d4873a (rerun). Both tui-fixture.py drivers are deleted and replaced by the Go tools/pi-tui-fixture, the fork fixtures use /bin/sh, and build.mjs extracts with /usr/bin/tar. The check no longer exempts whole lines that contain an allowed name. Criterion 2: Makefile GATE_STEPS includes no-python-runtime-dependency-test (Makefile:41, target :207-210); the GOC-V0-008 trace row names the gate step (docs/specs/go-only-cutover-v0.md:152). NOT_RUN: make pi-protected-build and PPI-V0-001/002, so the build.mjs tar path is exercised only on synthetic archives; the PTY fixture on Linux (compiled and vetted only). Follow-ups: AHI-002 fixed 1 s prompt delay flaked once under load; the new gate step has no gate-ledger scopes entry, so it is never cached (GL-V0-003). Sealed at .corvint/changes/5397b08e3e8d122461faea592d2d57918a63e12e.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 6d4873a of the sealed CEM, no-python-runtime-dependency_test.sh, Makefile, go-only-cutover-v0.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).
